hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read fp; [ -z "$fp" ] && exit 0; for pattern in .env .env.local production.yaml package-lock.json pnpm-lock.yaml yarn.lock .git/ node_modules/ dist/ build/ __pycache__/; do case "$fp" in *"$pattern"*) echo "BLOCKED: Writing to $fp is not allowed." >&2; exit 2;; esac; done; } || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read cmd; [ -z "$cmd" ] && exit 0; branch=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git commit' && echo "$branch" | grep -qE '^(main|master|dev)$'; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot commit directly on $branch. Create a feature branch first." >&2; exit 2; fi; } || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read cmd; [ -z "$cmd" ] && exit 0; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push.*(origin\s+)?(main|master|dev)(\s|$)'; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot push directly to protected branch. Use PR workflow." >&2; exit 2; fi; } || true
jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read cmd; [ -z "$cmd" ] && exit 0; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git push.*--force'; then echo "BLOCKED: Force push is not allowed." >&2; exit 2; fi; } || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read fp; [ -z "$fp" ] && exit 0; if echo "$fp" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv run ruff format "$fp" 2>/dev/null; elif echo "$fp" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|css|json|md)$'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx prettier --write "$fp" 2>/dev/null; fi; } || true

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | head -20 | xargs -I {} grep -l 'console\.log\|console\.debug\|print(' {} 2>/dev/null | head -5 | { files=$(cat); if [ -n "$files" ]; then echo "WARNING: Debug statements found in modified files:" >&2; echo "$files" | while read f; do echo "  - $f" >&2; done; fi; } || true
